title: TANFAC Industries Limited: Fluorine Chemistry, HFC-32 Execution and the Price of Growth
archetype: Capital-intensive integrated fluorine-chemistry platform moving downstream into higher-value products; conditional on execution, spreads and cash conversion.
primer: TANFAC is an integrated Indian fluorine-chemicals maker with a decades-old HF platform. It has completed HF and solar-grade DHF expansions and is close to commissioning a 20,000-TPA HFC-32 project. At ₹3,349.40 on November 13, 2026, the shares trade near 99 times trailing earnings while recent free cash flow remains negative after capex. The base value is ₹2,800 and the probability-weighted value is ₹2,790; new capital is REJECTED and the recommended action is to exit the existing 55 shares at the next available session. [1][4][6][12][35]
holding_rationale: The same-session Zerodha ledger shows 55 TANFACIND shares, ₹184,217 market value, ₹173,945.55 cost basis, ₹10,271.45 unrealized gain and 4.28% of portfolio net worth. The base target is ₹2,800 and the probability-weighted value is ₹2,790, both below the ₹3,349.40 close; the red-team 20%-margin stress values the share near ₹2,174. Recommend exiting all 55 shares at the next available session after checking the live quote and liquidity. The project’s bull case remains possible, but it does not offset the negative expected-value and cash-conversion evidence for this position. This is advisory only; no broker order or transaction-log edit is made. The ledger’s last recorded trade is November 11, 2026 and is treated as authoritative per workflow policy.

sizing_table_takeaway: Scenario prices are analyst cases, not guidance or consensus. The ₹5,000 bull value has a 20% weight; its full arithmetic appears in Chapter 9’s Scenario Math table. It uses the upper end of management’s FY27/FY28 growth guidance, assumes 20% further FY29 sales growth and a 26% EBITDA margin, then uses ₹40 crore D&A, ₹8 crore finance cost, ₹4 crore other income, 25% tax, 2.181 crore shares and a 32x exit P/E. The bridge gives ₹339.72 crore PAT, ₹155.76 EPS and ₹4,984, rounded to ₹5,000. Bear/base/bull weights of 30%/50%/20% give ₹2,790 expected value. No new entry is authorized. [1][6]
